Looking at this qlang documentation and the tasks, I need to write 14 queries. Let me work through each systematically, understanding the pipeline syntax, filtering, mapping, and grouping operations.

Let me trace through key concepts:
- `|` pipes values; `filter ~(...)` filters with conditions
- `at` reads softly (returns null if missing); `coalesce` provides defaults
- `lower`/`upper` for case conversion; `map` transforms; `groupBy` groups
- For files: JSON files are objects, text files are strings (use `lines` to split)

T1: Count active users with non-null emails ending "@example.com" (case-insensitive):
- Filter by: active=true AND email not null AND email (lowercased) ends with "@example.com"

T2: Users with "admin" role (case-insensitive), return names sorted by lowercase:
- Filter users whose roles array contains "admin" (any, lowercased)
- Map to names, sort by lowercase

T3: Count users per country, "unknown" for missing/null country:
- Group by `at /profile/country | coalesce "unknown"`
- Map count per group

T4: Average age of users with non-null age, round to 2 decimals:
- Map to extract ages (using `at` to handle missing)
- Filter out nulls
- Average and round

T5: Open issues' label names, lowercased, deduplicated, sorted:
- Filter state="open"
- Extract labels, flatten, extract names
- Lowercase, deduplicate with `distinct`, convert set to vector with `sort`

T6: Top 3 issues by comments (desc), ties broken by number (asc):
- Sort by `[(/comments | desc) /number]`
- Take 3, map to required format

T7: Count open issues per assignee login (exclude nulls):
- Filter open, extract assignee logins, filter non-null
- Group and count

T8: Dependencies + devDependencies with "^" versions, sorted by name:
- Merge with `union`, get entries
- Filter version starts with "^"
- Map to "name@version" format, sort

T9: Services with enabled=true and port>8000, lowercased names joined:
- Filter by conditions, map names, lowercase, sort, join

T10: Count ERROR lines per service (3rd token):
- Split lines by space, filter where token 1 = "ERROR"
- Extract token 2 (service), group and count

T11: Average of ms=<integer> values, round to 1 decimal:
- For each line, extract "ms=<int>" tokens, parse values
- Average and round

T12: Revenue (qty*price) for shipped status (non-empty price), round to 2:
- Parse CSV rows, filter by price and status="shipped"
- Sum qty*price, round

T13: Top 2 customers by total spend (excluding cancelled and empty price):
- Parse CSV, filter, group by customer, sum spend per customer
- Sort descending by total, take 2

T14: Word list - lowercase, deduplicate, sort by length desc then alphabetically, join:
- Use `count` (not `length`) for string length
- Sort by `[(/count | desc) /]`

T1: /data/users | filter ~(allOf /active (at /email | ne null) (at /email | lower | endsWith "@example.com")) | count

T2: /data/users | filter ~(/roles | any ~(lower | eq "admin")) | map /name | sort ~(lower)

T3: /data/users | groupBy ~(at /profile/country | coalesce "unknown") | map count

T4: /data/users | map ~(at /profile/age) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 2

T5: / | filter ~(/state | eq "open") | map /labels | flat | map /name | map ~lower | distinct | sort

T6: / | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | map {:number /number, :assignee (at /assignee/login)}

T7: / | filter ~(/state | eq "open") | map (at /assignee/login) | filter ~(ne null) | groupBy / | map count

T8: (/dependencies | union /devDependencies) | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | map ~([/0, /1] | join "@") | sort

T9: /services | filter ~(allOf (/enabled | coalesce false) (/port | gt 8000)) | map /name | map ~lower | sort | join ","

T10: / | lines | filter ~(split " " | /1 | eq "ERROR") | map ~(split " " | /2) | groupBy / | map count

T11: / | lines | map (split " " | filter ~(startsWith "ms=") | map ~(split "=" | /1) | map ~(parseJson)) | flat | avg | round 1

T12: / | lines | drop 1 | map (split ",") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") | map {:qty (parseJson /3), :price (parseJson /4), :status (/5 | lower)} | filter ~(/status | eq "shipped") | map ~(/qty * /price) | sum | round 2

T13: / | lines | drop 1 | map (split ",") | filter ~(allOf (/4 | ne "") (/5 | lower | ne "cancelled")) | map {:customer /1, :spend ((parseJson /3) * (parseJson /4))} | groupBy /customer | entries | map {:customer /0, :total (/1 | map /spend | sum | round 2)} | sort ~([(/total | desc)]) | take 2

T14: ["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] | map ~lower | distinct | sort ~([(/count | desc) /]) | join "-"
